result.summary: Closed ISS-0274 per WF-03 Step 5. Root cause: web/tsconfig.json is a solution-style root config ("files": [], project references only to tsconfig.app.json/tsconfig.node.json), so the previous type-check script `tsc --noEmit` compiled zero files against the root config and silently passed regardless of real type errors in the referenced project configs. Fix (Step 3, FRONTEND-DEV, security gate out-of-scope, idiom review PASS): web/package.json's type-check script changed to `tsc -b tsconfig.json`, which runs in build mode and walks the real referenced project configs (964 files per --listFiles). Verified via fail-then-pass command-output proof rather than a new test file, since Step 4 (TEST-DESIGNER) independently confirmed this is a build-config-only change with no ExUnit/vitest-exercisable surface, matching WF-02 Step 3's project/build-configuration exemption: npm run type-check failed with TS2322 (Type 'string' is not assignable to type 'number') against a deliberately injected type error in web/src/main.tsx, then passed at exit 0 after the injected line was reverted (confirmed via zero-diff git diff --stat); npm run build and the combined npm run check gate (type-check + lint + 178 vitest unit tests + 48 guard tests) both remained green post-fix. Full command output is in handoffs/WF03-ISS0274-20260822/step-03-frontend-dev.json. github_issue 542 was reachable via gh: closed with `gh issue close 542 --comment "Fixed in WF03-ISS0274-20260822. Regression proof (build-config-only change, no ExUnit/vitest surface): npm run type-check failed with TS2322 against a deliberately injected type error, then passed after reverting it. See handoffs/WF03-ISS0274-20260822/step-03-frontend-dev.json for full command output."` -- confirmed closed via `gh issue close` output: 'Closed issue tvolodi/letflow#542'.
